description: R and Python scripts compare methods for predicting and forecasting drinking-water pipe condition. The archive includes pipe CSV tables and information about utility and geospatial sources. This resource is provided by Thomas, Meghna; Dorian, Bethany; Iguchi, Takayuki and coauthors. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: It supports one condition-assessment study and requires the archived readme for detailed variable definitions. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
